plugins.name: claude-wiki
plugins.description: Karpathy-style LLM wiki. SessionEnd hook enqueues each Claude Code session; /wiki-ingest classifies queued sessions + manually-dropped inbox notes into an 8-category Obsidian vault (00_self / 01_inbox / 02_diary / 03_work / 04_life / 05_learn / 06_output / 07_archive). Ships /wiki-distill, /wiki-query, /wiki-lint, /wiki-status, plus /wiki-next and /wiki-weekly which loop the vault (past) with a weekly todo repo (future).

plugins.name: dev-standards
plugins.description: Coding standards enforced by tools: a PostToolUse hook runs ruff (bandit rules), shellcheck and gitleaks on each edited file and feeds back only the findings that edit introduced. A short skill names the references (OWASP ASVS, CWE Top 25, PEP 8, Google Shell Style). sync-repo.sh copies the same hook into a repo so Claude Code on the web enforces it too.
